goal: Verify hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot commitments during standard initial block download
Allow nodes running full sync to independently audit baked-in snapshot hashes against history
agreement: Substantive support for crowdsourcing snapshot hash audits during IBD (Sjors, optout21)
Objections to stopping IBD on mismatch resolved by switching to a warning (Sjors, ajtowns)
Confirmed the assertion abort on validation failure is fixed (fametrano)
Suggestion to persist the mismatch warning across node restarts remains open (fametrano)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it adds an audit check of snapshot commitments rather than fixing a consensus bug
Benefit is limited to crowdsourcing trust in AssumeUTXO hashes across nodes running full sync
